tips.text: Buy extra relics for the Receiver; every one of them carries it as the Rare.
Bank Aya before the window opens; neither Aya nor relics expire when her stock rotates.
Refine the Barrel and Receiver relics to Radiant and run them in a Radiant radshare.
Leave the Blueprint relics Intact; Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Pick a teammate's identical reward on the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
